1: Aey apne kapdon mein lipte hue (yani Nabi ﷺ).
2: Raat mein namaz parhein siwaye us ke thode hisse ke.
3: Us ke aadhe hisse mein namaz parhein agar aap chaahein, ya aadhe se kuchh kam parhein yahan tak ke aap ek tihai tak pahunchein.
4: Ya use barha dein yahan tak ke aap do tihai tak pahunchein. Quran ko saaf parhein jab aap us ki tilawat karein aur use thehar thehar kar parhein.
5: Hum aap par, aey Rasool, woh Quran nazil karne wale hain jo ek bhaari baat hai, un faraiz, hadon, ahkam, adaab wagera ki wajah se jo us mein hain.
6: Raat ki ghadiyan tilawat ke liye dil ke zyada munasib hain aur baat mein zyada durust.
7: Din mein aap apne kaam mein mashghool hote hain, aur Quran ki tilawat se gaafil rehte hain, pas raat mein namaz parhein.
8: Allah ko zikr ki mukhtalif soorton se yaad karein, aur apne aap ko poori tarah us ke liye waqf kar dein, woh paak hai, apni ibadat sirf us hi ke liye kar ke.
9: Poorab ka Rubb aur pachchim ka Rubb. Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laayaq nahin. Pas use apna kaarsaaz bana lein jis par aap apne tamam maamlon mein bharosa karein.
10: Un baaton par sabr karein jo jhutlane wale mazaaq aur gaali ke tor par kehte hain, aur unhein is tarah chhod dein jis se koi nuqsan na ho.
11: Un logon ke haal ki fikr na karein jo jhutlate hain, jo duniya ki lazzaton se faida uthate hain. Unhein mere hawale chhod dein aur un ke liye thoda intezar karein yahan tak ke un ka muqarrar waqt aa jaaye.
12: Aakhirat mein mere paas bhaari zanjeerein aur ek bhadakti aag hai.
13: Aur ek aisa khana jo apni shadeed karwahat ki wajah se galon mein phansta hai, aur ek dard-naak azaab, is ke oopar.
14: Woh azaab jhutlane walon par us din aayega jab zameen aur pahaad hilenge aur pahaad apni shadeed dehshat ki wajah se bikhri hui behti ret ban jaayenge.
15: Hum ne tumhari taraf ek Rasool bheja jo Qayamat ke din tumhare aamaal par gawah hoga, jaise Hum ne Firaun ki taraf ek Rasool bheja, jo Moosa (alaihis salaam) the.
16: Lekin Firaunhon ne us Rasool ki nafarmani ki jo us ke Rubb ki taraf se us ki taraf bheja gaya, pas Hum ne use duniya mein doba kar aur aakhirat mein aag ke azaab se sakht azaab diya. Pas tum apne Rasool ki nafarmani na karo warna tum par woh aa padega jo us par aaya.
17: Pas tum apne aap ko kaise bachaoge, agar tum Allah ka inkar karo aur us ke Rasool ko jhutlao, ek lambe, sakht din se jo chhote bachchon ke sar safed kar dega, apni dehshat ki shiddat aur apni tawaalat ki wajah se.
18: Aasman us ki dehshat se phat jayega. Allah ka waada yaqeenan poora hoga.
19: Yeh nasihat, jis mein Qayamat ke din ki dehshat aur shiddat ka bayan hai, ek yaad-dihani hai jo mominon ke liye faide-mand hai. Pas jo chahe ke ek aisa raasta le jo us ke Rubb tak pahunchata hai use le lena chahiye.
20: Aap ka Rubb, aey Rasool, jaanta hai ke aap kabhi raat ke do tihai se kam namaz mein guzarte hain, kabhi aap aadhi raat khade rehte hain, kabhi ek tihai, aur mominon ka ek giroh aap ke saath khada hota hai. Allah raat aur din ka andaza karta hai aur un ki ghadiyan ginta hai. Woh, woh paak hai, jaanta hai ke aap us ki ghadiyan ginn aur un ka hisaab rakh nahin sakte, aur chunanche us ka zyada hissa matloob ko chaahte hue khada rehna aap ke liye mushkil hoga. Is liye us ne aap ki tauba qabool kar li. Pas raat mein utni namaz parhein jitni aap ke liye aasan ho. Allah jaanta hai ke tum mein se kuchh, aey mominon, bimaar ho sakte hain aur bimari se majboor, kuchh safar mein honge Allah ka rizq talash karte hue, aur kuchh kafiron se lar rahe honge Allah ki raza chaahte hue aur Allah ka kalma buland karne ke liye. In logon ke liye raat ko namaz mein khada rehna mushkil hai, pas raat mein utni namaz parho jitni tumhare liye aasan ho aur farz namaz behtareen tareeqe se ada karo. Apne maal ki zakaat do aur apne maal mein se Allah ke raaste mein kharch karo. Jo bhalai tum apne liye aage bhejo, tum use behtar aur ajar mein bada paoge. Allah se bakshish maango. Allah apne un bandon ko bakshne wala hai jo tauba karte hain aur woh un par reham karne wala hai.
